## Checklist

- [ ] No fabricated data, placeholder values or sample charts
- [ ] No undocumented vendor endpoints; unsupported capabilities are reported with a reason
- [ ] Changes to the network are verified by reading the device back, and audited
- [ ] No secrets in code, tests, logs or this pull request
- [ ] New logic has a test that fails when it breaks
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `CHANGELOG.md`; `docs/TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md` for architectural changes)
